name: Neo Sonic Fighting Heroes
summary: In an effort to stay prepared for any future attacks from Eggman, Tails builds a simulation room which allows the user to generate any world they please, alongside a combatant which is indistinguishable from their real life counterpart. This room also allows for 2 people to enter at once, allowing for a more immersive sparring session. All your dream battles will happen here!
